statement.p: A town has 3300 registered residents. Among them, 37\% were Democrats, 30\% were Republicans. The rest were Independents. How many registered Independents live in this town?
There are registered Independent residents in this town.

So there are 33\% Independents. Now this problem can be boiled down to this question: What is 33\% of 3300? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem. Assume 33\% of 3300 is x, so 33 out of 100 corresponds to x out of 3300.
We will write and solve the proportion:
There are 1089 registered Independent residents in this town.
